quotes.text: We had a great time on the Kohala Coast Tour! Our pilot James was very knowledgeable and a great pilot! We even added the waterfall landing at Laupahoehoe Nui. Gorgeous!

It was simply stunning!! The untouched natural beauty of Kauai was on full display during this tour. While I would take photos and videos on this tour, I would highly recommend taking in the beauty of this tour while in the air and getting the entire video from them after. Our pilot Alex was simply amazing. He was very informative and provided all of the passengers a great view of the island sights

Unbelievably worth it :) Shane was an AMAZING pilot and people person. He knew a lot about the area and was excited to share it. Went out of the way to make extra loops to be sure EVERYONE had an opportunity to see everything. Shane's personally curated music choices really made for an easy decision to also purchase the video of our trip. Freaking awesome!

Herb is the best Pilot, the entire staff was very informative and friendly. We felt very welcome. The flight was just priceless!! We count our selfs blessed to be able to enjoy such an amazing adventure!!
We had a great time. KJ was awesome! Definitely would do it again. The views from above were exceptionally beautiful! Thank you for making our visit special Missy & Jay
Definately a fun experience but chances are one of you will be in a middle seat. Also the flight time was shorter than advertised, we were in the air maybe 30 mins
